name: LinPrim Population Control
definition: Processes to prune undesired primitives and create new ones to control population, adapting 3DGS methods for novel primitives.
summary: LinPrim Population Control manages linear primitive density in differentiable volume rendering by pruning, cloning, and splitting to adapt to scene complexity, differing from Gaussian Splatting by accommodating non-spherical kernels and anisotropic geometry.
